title: andropogon scoparius var. littoralis
intro: Andropogon scoparius var. littoralis, commonly known as Little Bluestem, is a type of grass native to North America. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial actions that may aid in wound healing and reducing the risk of infection. The therapeutic actions of Little Bluestem are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpenes and phenolic compounds that exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its medicinal properties and potential applications.
